metadata.title: Haupaix et al. (2018) Science, Inaba et al. (2019) PNAS & Lin et al. (2013) Science — Somite-Prepatterned Agouti Signaling, Melanocyte Reaction-Diffusion and Feather-Follicle Ring-Niche Coupling in Avian Plumage Stripes
metadata.pass3_citation_corrections: 2026-10-19: Haupaix et al. (2018) title corrected to the published one (PMID 30237324); Inaba et al. (2019) venue/DOI corrected to PNAS 116(14):6884-6890, doi:10.1073/pnas.1816107116 (PMID 30886106). Passes 1-2 cited a non-existent title and a non-existent Science article.

sources.citation: Haupaix N, Curantz C, Bailleul R, Beck S, Robic A, Manceau M (2018). The periodic coloration in birds forms through a prepattern of somite origin. Science 361(6408):eaar4777.

Inaba M, Jiang TX, Liang YC, Tsai S, Lai YC, Widelitz RB, Chuong CM (2019). Instructive role of melanocytes during pigment pattern formation of the avian skin. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 116(14):6884-6890.

Bailleul R, Curantz C, Desmarquet-Trin Dinh C, Hidalgo M, Touboul J, Manceau M (2019). Symmetry breaking in the embryonic skin triggers directional and sequential plumage patterning. PLOS Biology 17(10):e3000448.

coturnix_japonica_dorsal.species: Coturnix japonica (Japanese quail exhibiting periodic longitudinal dorsal buff-yellow pheomelanin and dark brown-black eumelanin plumage stripes)
coturnix_japonica_dorsal.author: Wayne Cheng (Wikimedia Commons)

somite_agouti_reaction_diffusion_model.section: Haupaix et al. (2018) Science Figs. 1-4 & Inaba et al. (2019) Science Figs. 2-4

governing_pde.u_eq: du/dt = D_u * laplacian(u) + alpha_u * u^2 / (v * (1 + kappa * u^2)) - gamma_u * u + beta_A * S_somite(y)
governing_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = D_v * laplacian(v) + alpha_v * u^2 - gamma_v * v
governing_pde.somite_prepattern: S_somite(y) = sum_k A_somite * exp(-(y - y_k)^2 / (2 * sigma_somite^2)) + A_bead * exp(-((x - x_b)^2 + (y - y_b)^2) / (2 * sigma_bead^2))
governing_pde.pigment_switch_law: Yellow pheomelanin synthesized where Agouti/activator u(x,y) >= theta_A (MC1R antagonism); Black eumelanin synthesized where u(x,y) < theta_A
governing_pde.stripe_width_partition: w_yellow + w_black = Lambda_somite (somite-specified dorsoventral stripe period)

interspecific_somite_grafting_experiment.section: Haupaix et al. (2018) Science Fig. 3 (Heterospecific Somite-to-Dermis Chimeras)

agouti_bead_perturbation_regimes.description: Dominant-negative / RNAi suppression of dermal Agouti shrinks yellow pheomelanin stripes and expands black eumelanin domains
Control BSA bead implantation preserves wild-type Japanese quail yellow (0.42 mm) and black (0.53 mm) stripe widths
Moderate exogenous Agouti protein bead locally widens yellow pheomelanin stripe and narrows adjacent black eumelanin band
High Agouti protein bead produces strong local yellow band expansion (+0.29 mm) with complementary black band narrowing (-0.29 mm)
Saturating exogenous Agouti bead nearly bridges adjacent yellow stripes across the inter-stripe black domain

flags: galliform_species_panel[*].yellow_stripe_width_mm_ref / black_stripe_width_mm_ref / stripe_period_mm and the quail Lambda = 0.95 mm, w_y = 0.42 mm canonical widths are NOT values published by Haupaix et al. (2018); the paper reports stripe boundaries as distances from the dorsal midline (cb boundary 2-4 mm at wing level, 2-3 mm at leg level; ly boundary 3-9 mm at wing level, 3-6 mm at leg level) and stripe widths in feather rows (Fig. 1B-C, Fig. 3B). Their provenance is unverified and they are retained only for continuity with Passes 1-2.

agouti_bead_perturbation_regimes are NOT experiments of Haupaix et al. (2018); the paper's dose series is the recessive-black (RB-/-) and Fawn (Fa-/-) quail strains (Fig. 3B-C). ASIP-coated beads in regenerating feather follicles are from Lin et al. (2013) Fig. 3D and produce apigmented (white) zones, not yellow widening. The regime widths are unverified.

interspecific_somite_grafting_experiments: Haupaix et al. (2018) Fig. 4 report quail somite -> pheasant host grafts (and neural-tube grafts as negative control); the pheasant -> quail and guineafowl -> quail chimeras and alpha_donor = 0.94 are model extrapolations, not reported experiments.

somite_agouti_reaction_diffusion_model.governing_pde is the rational Gierer-Meinhardt-type form; the script integrates a cubic-saturating linearisation around (0.46, 0.46) with the same Jacobian sign structure (see 2018-haupaix-avian-plumage-somite-stripes.py integrate_somite_melanocyte_pde_2d).

haupaix2018_feather_row_benchmarks.section: Haupaix et al. (2018) Science 361:eaar4777 — Fig. 1, Fig. 3A-C, fig. S1, fig. S6 and main text (values transcribed from the published text)
stripe_sequence_from_midline: cb (central black, may contain a few central yellow cy feathers)

feather_types.y: yellow feather: pheomelanin band with black base and tip (readout of a transient yellow-production pulse)

coturnix_japonica_agouti_bands.A1prime: presumptive feather row 2 (first b/y feather of the ly stripe)
coturnix_japonica_agouti_bands.A1: feather rows 3-5 (rest of the ly stripe)
coturnix_japonica_agouti_bands.A2: central rows forming the cy stripe

recessive_black_RB.mechanism: agouti frameshift, marked decrease in transcript level; feathers switch back to eumelanin earlier (shorter yellow pulse); no visible cy stripe

fawn_Fa.mechanism: agouti duplication, increased expression; delayed switch to eumelanin (longer yellow pulse); no eumelanin seen before hatching

haupaix2018_feather_row_benchmarks.yellow_band_gradient_within_stripe: yellow band length is increased in feathers at the centre of ly stripes relative to those at the edge (fig. S1); no numeric value published
haupaix2018_feather_row_benchmarks.switch_measurements: 'switch to y' and 'switch to b' = distance (mm) from feather tip to the distal limit of the yellow band / black base (C. japonica E10-E11, n = 12 / 32); 'relative y band length' (%) = yellow band length / fully grown y feather length (fig. S6) — numeric values are in the paper's figures and were not digitised here

feather_follicle_niche_model.section: Lin et al. (2013) Science 340:1442-1445 Fig. 1-2, fig. S9 (ring niche, chevron bars) coupled to Haupaix et al. (2018) Fig. 3 (yellow-pulse duration) — Pass 3 reduced model
feather_follicle_niche_model.ring_niche: melanocyte progenitors form a horizontal ring in the proximal follicle (lower bulge / collar) and send melanocytes vertically up the epithelial cylinder into barb ridges; the proximodistal feather axis is a timing axis
feather_follicle_niche_model.chevron_law: opened cylinder (cut at the posterior new-barb locus): band edge s(ell) = s_0 + k * |ell|, ell in [-1, 1] lateral (rachis at 0), s in [0, 1] tip -> base; k = v_z / (r_f * omega) with omega the azimuthal propagation rate of the pigment switch around the ring from the rachis; k = 0 gives a transverse bar (Lean Theorem 4 ring_niche_chevron_geometry)
feather_follicle_niche_model.yellow_pulse_law: niche Agouti over feather growth tau in [0, 1]: A(tau) = A_i - a + a cos(2 pi (tau - 1/2)); feather type = [A_i >= theta_A] + [A_i - 2a >= theta_A] in {0: b, 1: y, 2: fully pheomelanic}; relative yellow band length duty = (1/pi) arccos((theta_A - (A_i - a)) / a) (Lean Theorem 5 agouti_pulse_duration_feather_type)
feather_follicle_niche_model.lattice: hexagonal follicle lattice, 9 feather rows per somitic stripe period (WT ly = 4 of 9 rows, Haupaix Fig. 3A), follicle niche dose A_i = bilinear sample of the body-wide u(x, y) field

parameters.note: a, k and the dose multipliers are free parameters: a and the multipliers were fitted so that WT / RB-/- / Fa-/- give 4 / 2 / 6 yellow rows and WT y feathers keep black base and tip; Lin et al. (2013) do not quantify the chevron pitch, so k is a sweep parameter checked against its own analytic law

not_modelled: barb-ridge mechanics and helical ridge displacement
pulp ASIP diffusion and the Barred Plymouth Rock progenitor depletion feedback
feather regeneration cycles and systemic hormonal control
mm calibration of follicle radius / feather length
